```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = FALSE,
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE,
  fig.width = 10,
  fig.height = 6,
  dpi = 300
)

source(here::here("analysis/comparison_utils.R"))

GRAPHS_DIR <- file.path(PROJECT_ROOT, "analysis", "figures")
dir.create(GRAPHS_DIR, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

pacman::p_load(
  lme4,
  lmerTest,
  patchwork,
  emmeans,
  effectsize
)

theme_set(theme_comparison())
```

# Load Data

```{r load-data}
df_raw <- load_story_metrics() 
df_lag <- load_lag_profiles()
df_sentence_index <- load_sentence_index()
df_raw %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_stories = n_distinct(conversation_id),
    n_turns = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Loaded data by condition")

df_lag %>%
  group_by(condition) %>%
  summarise(
    n_stories = n_distinct(story_id),
    n_turns = n(),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  knitr::kable(caption = "Loaded data by condition")

```


```{r}
summarize_by_condition(df_raw, "straightness")

annotation_trajectory_model <- lm(mean_coherence_element_consistency ~ mean_step * cond, data = df_raw)

summary(annotation_trajectory_model)
```

```{r}
plot_metric_boxplots(df_raw, "mean_coherence_element_consistency", "mean_step", "Step cosine")
```
